texts.li: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} stayed up talking long after the others had gone to bed.
By the last of the fire, {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} talked about the homes they had left behind.
Neither {A_nameDef} nor {B_nameDef} could sleep, so they sat up talking until the sky went gray.
{A_nameDef} muttered a remark about the stew at dinner, and {B_nameDef} laughed so hard {B_pronoun} had to leave the table.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} have a joke between them now, and one word of it at supper is enough to set them both off.
{A_nameDef} did an impression of the last raider leader. {B_nameDef} cried laughing.
{A_nameDef} filled {B_nameDef}'s boots with sand. {B_nameDef} swore revenge, laughing.
{A_nameDef} sewed {B_nameDef}'s shirt sleeves shut in the night, and {B_nameDef} laughed about it all through breakfast.
{A_nameDef} hid {B_nameDef}'s tools as a joke, and {B_nameDef} lost half a day looking for them.
{A_nameDef} put a dead rat in {B_nameDef}'s bed as a joke. {B_nameDef} has stopped speaking to {A_objective}.
{B_nameDef} said good morning at the well, and {A_nameDef} turned and walked away without a word.
{A_nameDef} moved {A_possessive} chair to the far end of the table when {B_nameDef} sat down.
{A_nameDef} thanked each person who helped with the harvest by name, and left out {B_nameDef}.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} argued until supper over whose turn it was to clean the latrine.
{A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} to put the tools back where they belong, and {B_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} to do it {A_objective}self.
The fire went out overnight, and {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} spent breakfast arguing over whose job it had been.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} went over the last battle again at dinner, from the first warning to the last of the wounded carried in.
{A_nameDef} showed {B_nameDef} {A_possessive} newest scar, {B_nameDef} showed a worse one, and they drank to both.
{A_nameDef} spent the evening showing {B_nameDef} the finer points of {SKILL}, and by the end {B_nameDef} had it.
{B_nameDef} made the same {SKILL} mistake three times running, and {A_nameDef} patiently explained it again until the next try came out right.
{A_nameDef} set {B_nameDef} a {SKILL} exercise, watched without a word, and nodded once at the end.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} turned the woodcutting into a contest. {A_nameDef} won, and told the table about it at supper.
{A_nameDef} beat {B_nameDef} at horseshoes, then at cards, then at arm-wrestling, and {B_nameDef} wants a rematch at all three.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} made a race out of hauling, and {A_nameDef} won by a single sack.
{A_nameDef} carved {B_nameDef} a small figure out of scrap wood. {B_nameDef} keeps it by {B_possessive} bed.
{A_nameDef} painted {B_nameDef}'s name on {B_possessive} door with a border of flowers, and {B_nameDef} stood looking at it a long while.
{A_nameDef} painted a picture of {B_nameDef}'s old home from {B_possessive} description, and {B_nameDef} hung it over the bed.
{A_nameDef} has been repeating what {B_nameDef} says in {B_possessive} sleep, and {B_nameDef} found out.
{A_nameDef} has a theory about where {B_nameDef} really came from, and has shared it widely. {B_nameDef} is furious.
{A_nameDef} has been mocking {B_nameDef}'s accent behind {B_possessive} back, and {B_nameDef} overheard.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} ended up on the same work detail and, somewhere around noon, started talking like people.
{A_nameDef} held the ladder steady for {B_nameDef} on the roof job, and for the rest of the afternoon they managed to be civil.
{A_nameDef} brought {B_nameDef} a bowl of stew without being asked, and {B_nameDef} said thank you.
When someone blamed {A_nameDef} for the burnt dinner, {B_nameDef} stepped in and took half the blame.
{B_nameDef} told the whole table that anyone with a problem with {A_nameDef} had a problem with {B_objective} too.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} spent the afternoon building a fort out of crates, with a rule that no grown-ups may enter.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} found a beetle and argued until supper about what to name it.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} raced each other round the storehouse until they were too out of breath to argue about who had won.
A passing remark of {B_nameDef}'s over dinner gave {A_nameDef} an idea, and {A_nameDef} has been hard at work on it since.
{B_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} an idle question at supper, and {A_nameDef} went straight from the table to work on the answer.
